title: Salt Lake E-Bike Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This tour of Salt Lake City takes you to new heights, getting into the mountains and shaded beautiful canyons. We ride our bikes next to the creek, giving us a chance to feel the snowmelt that is the lifeblood of our town, and we gain mountainside views of the whole Salt Lake Valley, right next to downtown!
